source_lines_after.56: The left panel shows the glued graph for the right action: $x:2\to0$ is above $d_1:2\to2$. The two identified sites form one closed loop, and the bottom arc survives as $x$. The right panel shows the form computation $x\circ x^*:0\to0$: $x$ is above its horizontal reflection $x^*$, so there is one loop and no exterior boundary.
